blocks.task_summary: Find the largest value of the eldest child's age c that would not be considered an outlier, using the given box and whisker diagram (min=2, Q1=6, median=7, Q3=10, max=18).
method_path: Read Q1=6 and Q3=10 from the box plot
Compute upper fence: Q3 + 1.5 x IQR = 10 + 1.5 x 4 = 10 + 6 = 16

evidence.basis: IQR = 10 - 6 (=4) (A1); attempt to find Q3 + 1.5 x IQR (M1); 10 + 6 = 16 (A1)

blocks.task_summary: (i) Estimate the eldest child's age for an adult aged 42 using the regression line of c on a: c = (1/2)a - 9. (ii) Find the mean age of all adults by solving the system formed by the two regression lines at their intersection point.
method_path: (i) Substitute a = 42 into c = a/2 - 9 to obtain c = 12
(ii) Solve the system of the two regression lines at the mean point by substitution or elimination to find a-bar = 34

evidence.basis: (i) choosing c = (1/2)a - 9 (M1); 1/2 x 42 - 9 = 12 (years old) (A1). (ii) attempt to solve system by substitution or elimination (M1); 34 (years old) (A1)
